content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms often impose hefty fees and restrictions that can cripple a digital creator’s ability to monetize their work. For instance, platforms like Gumroad charge up to 10% on every sale, which significantly eats into profits. In contrast, COREMERCH's infrastructure leverages NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%. This difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921. The architecture allows you to take ownership of your digital commerce, operate outside the constraints of financial gatekeepers, and realize true profitability.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need a few essential components. Ensure you have a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, as these platforms provide free hosting services. You’ll also need access to Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and order processing. Consider setting up a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions, which opens your sales funnel to over 300 cryptocurrencies. Lastly, prepare your digital products, whether ebooks, templates, or courses, for easy integration into the system.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for seamless transactions. Start by deploying your chosen stack, either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack, depending on your needs. Integrate NOWPayments into your stack to facilitate crypto payments, ensuring you configure it to accept various cryptocurrencies. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery, triggering fulfillment as soon as payment is confirmed on-chain. This setup will provide a frictionless experience for your customers and ensure prompt delivery of your digital products.
Retain more of your earnings with lower fees on crypto transactions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your digital store and promote it through your networks. To process your first transaction, create a test product and make a purchase using a cryptocurrency wallet. Monitor the transaction to ensure that payment confirmation triggers the automated delivery correctly. This first transaction is crucial; it validates your entire setup and serves as a proof of concept for your digital store’s operations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure running smoothly, consider scaling your operations. Evaluate customer feedback and analytics to identify popular products and adjust your offerings accordingly. You can easily expand your inventory by adding more digital products to your store. Leverage NOWPayments' integration to accept more cryptocurrencies, opening your store to a global audience. As you grow, consider utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to further enhance your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates crypto payments. Platforms like NOWPayments allow you to process transactions with minimal fees, ensuring more revenue retention. This method eliminates dependency on conventional payment processors, giving you full ownership of your online store.
Automate delivery and payment processing for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It provides everything needed to create and manage a sovereign digital store, ensuring you can operate independently from traditional payment systems.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your store. Set up NOWPayments for crypto transactions with low fees. Choose either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your site. Prepare your digital products for upload. Deploy your payment processing logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Test your setup with a dummy transaction to ensure everything works correctly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell my digital products without using PayPal or Stripe?

You can utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates crypto payments through NOWPayments. This allows you to sell directly and retain more revenue without relying on traditional payment processors.
What are the transaction fees when using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a nominal fee of 0.5% on each transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This means more money stays in your pocket.
Can I automate product delivery for my digital downloads?
Yes, you can automate product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring your customers receive their purchases instantly upon payment confirmation.
What types of digital products can I sell?
You can sell a variety of digital products including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, and software. The infrastructure supports all these formats seamlessly.
Is there ongoing support after I deploy my stack?
Yes, when you purchase the Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support to help you troubleshoot and optimize your setup after deployment.
